name: icat_extract
description: Extract one Sleuth Kit address (an inode, or inode-type-id for an NTFS stream such as 168-128-4) from a disk image to a NEW file under the run, streaming icat's output through a hash so no size is held in memory; an existing output is never replaced. Refuses an inode the catalogue lists only as a directory (icat would give its index). Returns the path, size, sha256, image, volume offset in sectors, the sector size passed to icat (-b, when given), the address asked for, icat's exit code and where its stderr is kept, and the path(s) the catalogue lists for exactly that address. An output budget (max_bytes) and a time budget (max_seconds) bound it; a run that hits one or whose icat fails part way keeps its bytes as <output>.partial and reports status partial, never a truncated file under the real name. It extracts what the record's data runs hold now: for a deleted entry that may be another file's bytes, and a matching header or size is a check, not proof.

inode.description: Sleuth Kit inode/address to extract, for example 168 or 168-128-4 for an NTFS stream

output.description: New output file path (relative to the sandbox); refused if it exists. In a job it must lie under $OUT: give {OUT}/<name>, or work/extracted/<your id>/<name>, which the harness maps there

image.description: Image path. Defaults to the single disk image under inputs/: one with a disk image's extension, or one the catalogue read as a disk (catalog/<input>/partitions.txt).

offset.description: Volume offset in sectors for icat -o. Defaults to the one filesystem the catalogue lists for the image (catalog/<input>/p<start>/); several mean pass it; none is 0.

sector_size.description: Sector size in bytes for icat -b (a multiple of 512), when the image's is not 512; the same value image_layout used

max_bytes.description: Output budget in bytes (default 32 GiB); past it the run stops and keeps a .partial

max_seconds.description: Time budget in seconds (default 1500, at most 1700); past it the run stops and keeps a .partial
